notes.title: Great news!
notes.content:
Great news! A while back we already updated the entire game with free contents (PC version).
Please visit our Twitter & Website for more awesome new stuff that we are making.

notes.title: Latest on the new content!
notes.content:
Its a spin-off full game to be released on other platforms, with hours of gameplay.  For the people who think the current story mode is too hard, playing the new game mode will unlock all levels.

Again, we intent to release it free for all owners of Steam version of Akuatica. When will it be available?  Its done but we are in the middle of a console port.  After that it will be converted into the Steam version.

We are a small team, have to do it one at a time.  Please keep an eye on our website, will have new images & videos there soon...

notes.title: What's in the planned free update?
notes.content:
Its a game mode slightly similar to that of Tower Defense.  This give players an alternative to unlock all levels and achievements by defeating waves of enemies.

Its currently play testing on another platform, will be available here Free.

notes.title: Adding a new game mode
notes.content: A new game mode is in the testing & polishing phrase.  Whether is will be a DLC or just a big patch it's not yet decided. But it will be free for Akuatica owners.
